_about: 问签 v1 → v2 (Hanli 2026-11-02: 「可以, 按你说的做」 — the rewards, the v1 scope, then v2: one full reading, 替人求签, a share image; rules/fortune.mjs, rules/almanac.mjs, guide/qian.md, doc/design.md § 问签). One 签 a real day from the 签筒, seeded by the day and the save. `qian`: the traditional 观音灵签, all one hundred, each 签诗 and grade quoted exactly from the temple's own page (`source`, and each 签's `url`; typos kept as published, e.g. 签20's 开睛); `jie` (白话签解, 问签 v2) is the game's own plain Chinese rendering of what the verse says, and `gloss` its plain English one — neither a translation of record nor a reading of a life (no faithful public-domain English translation was found); no line of verse is ever added. `grades`: the 签's grade as the source states it, and the day's 修为 `speed` it gives (上上 ×1.2, stepping down to ×1.0 at 中 and below — never under 1: a bad draw takes nothing). `yi`: the one kind of play the 签 names 宜 today — each 签's own `kind`, tagged once and fixed (问签 v2) by THE TAGGING RULE: the kind whose play is nearest the verse's main image — 斗法 (doufa) a match of wits, a rival or a hidden arrow, a net or trap to see through, gossip and empty words; 守御 (shouyu) waiting, keeping still, holding to the old, shelter, enduring the cold till spring; 文 (wen) learning and 功名, an upright heart, hidden worth recognised by a patron, family, marriage and song; 武 (wu) rising by effort, leaping the Dragon Gate, soaring, setting out, the road, the horse and the sword; where two fit, the verse's last line (its counsel) decides. Counts: 守御 31 · 文 25 · 斗法 22 · 武 22, whose 修为 pays ×`pay` today; `weight` is what the 时辰 pool may lean a game of that kind by (fortune.mjs yiWeightOf). A kind matches a grant by its system's tag (`plays`), else a board's mechanic (`mechanics`), else its table (`tables`). `streak`: 连签 — days in a row draw a finer 签筒. `yingyan`: 应验 — from `after_hour` 银月 may ask once whether the 宜 came true; an answer pays `pay` (the small `game` table) and is kept in the save. `signs`: the twelve 星座 by month·day (MMDD, from · to). `almanac`: the 黄历 tables (rules/almanac.mjs). `luck`: the 签's tone for each of the five 项 (事业 · 感情 · 财运 · 出行 · 健康; `aspects`). `aspects`: the 五项's lines. `friends`: 替人求签's limits.

games.zh: 灯谜 · 棋局 · 解谜

almanac._about: 黄历 of the day, deterministic (rules/almanac.mjs): 日柱 from the Julian Day (1949-10-01 甲子); 月建 by the 节 (立春 opens 寅, the 节 day the new month's); 年 at 立春; 建除 — 建 the day whose branch is the month's (《欽定協紀辨方書》卷四: 「其法從月建上起建，與斗勺所指相應，如正月建寅，則寅日起建，順行十二辰是也」; 「每月交節，則疊兩值日」), after 《淮南子·天文訓》 「寅為建，卯為除，辰為滿，巳為平，午為定，未為執，申為破，酉為危，戌為成，亥為收，子為開，丑為閉」; 冲 the opposite branch; 煞 the day's 三煞 (申子辰 南 · 寅午戌 北 · 亥卯未 西 · 巳酉丑 东). Each officer's 宜 · 忌 are read from the gods 《協紀辨方書》卷四 sets on it (`from`, quoted), https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/欽定協紀辨方書_(四庫全書本)/卷04 — these are the 建除 宜忌 alone; a printed almanac's full list adds many other 神煞 and is longer. Checked against published almanacs (tests/qian.test.mjs): 2025-11-06 己卯 执, 2025-11-08 辛巳 破 冲猪 煞东, 2025-11-20 癸巳 破, 2025-11-30 癸卯 定 (skillon.com Tong Shu 2025-11, the 丁亥 month from 11-07); 2025-11-07 庚辰 冲狗 煞南 (qmrl888 · tianqi 老黄历); 2026-11-02 丙午年 戊戌月 庚辰日 (wannianli.tianqi.com). On a 节 day itself, sites that turn the month at the 节's hour (skillon: 2025-11-07 破) differ from this day-level rule (执 — the 協紀辨方書's 疊兩值日).

officers.from: 建日吉多可用；小時：其日忌結姻親開倉庫
吉期：所值之日宜出軍行師攻城寨興弔伐㑹親姻；除為四利太陽小吉
福德：其日宜祀神祗求福願修宫室；天巫：宜合藥請醫；天狗：其日忌禱祀鬼神祈求福願
天罡 · 河魁：所值之日百事宜避；死神：其日忌請醫服藥出師征討種植樹木進人納畜
時隂：所值之日宜運謀算畫計䇿睦子孫㑹親友；官符：其日忌拜官視事上表章陳詞訟；死氣：其日忌戰鬬征伐療病求醫……經營栽植
枝德：其日宜修造築垣；小耗：其日忌經營種蒔納財交易開市
大耗：其日忌營庫藏出財物逺經求取債負
危為極富星為谷將星為四利龍德吉
天醫：其日宜請藥避病尋巫禱祀
時陽：所值之日宜叙婚姻行宴樂；生氣：其日宜修築城壘開道溝渠起土修營養育羣畜種蒔

checked_against.note: the same set in the same order; 39 poems identical, 8 differ in variant forms only, 50 in readings (buyiju's own 本作/有作 notes carry the temple's reading in 12 of them); 10 grades differ (2, 9, 17, 26, 34, 51, 52, 55, 59, 68). The temple's text and grades are kept.

source.titles: not shipped: the temple gives no 典故 title, and the only titles found (buyiju) conflict with a second site in 27 of 100.
source.english: no faithful public-domain or freely licensed English translation was found (the temple's English is All Rights Reserved; Karcher's The Kuan Yin Oracle, 2009, is in copyright): `gloss` is the game's own plain rendering.

aspects._about: 五项运势 (问签 v2, Hanli 2026-11-02; rules/fortune.mjs aspectsOf). Each 签 carries one tone per 项 (`luck`, in this order: up · even · slow), read once from its verse; the line is `lines[tone][(n + i) mod len]` (i the 项's place), then today's 黄历: the first of the 项's `ji` acts the day avoids, else the first of its `yi` acts the day favours, is added as 「今日忌…」/「今日宜…」. 财运 speaks in 宜/忌 only and never decides; 健康 stays light (sleep, water, a walk) and reads no 黄历 act — never a cure, a doctor or a medicine.

slow.en: slow down; sort it out first

up.en: good for collecting what is owed

friends._about: 替人求签 (问签 v2): a reading for someone else — their 签 seeded by the 称呼, the day and the save, the same all day; at most `per_day` people a day (a 称呼 asked again the same day takes no second place); never 修为, never the 宜. Kept in the save only by 称呼 and the signs a birthday gives (生肖 · 星座) — never the birthday — at most `keep` people, newest first; 「不保存」 keeps nothing but the day's count (a hash of the 称呼).

qian.jie: 天地开出一段良缘，时日正好，万事俱全；抽到这签非同小可，为人忠正，自有上头赏识。
qian.gloss: Heaven and earth begin a good match; the day is right and all is whole. An upright heart is called to honour.

qian.jie: 鲤鱼还没化龙，先守着江河，别急着往高处跳；等时候到了，自会一跃过龙门。
qian.gloss: The carp still keeps to the river and cannot rise yet; one day it changes and leaps the Dragon Gate.

qian.jie: 冒着风雨回乡，像燕子衔泥筑巢，巢坏了又得重新衔泥；事要反复做，辛苦难免。
qian.gloss: Home through wind and rain like a swallow: it carries mud to build its nest, and the nest crumbles, and it carries mud again.

qian.jie: 古镜破了又重圆，断了的缘分再续上；家门从此焕然一新，福禄还传到儿孙。
qian.gloss: An old mirror made whole again: broken bonds mend, the house is renewed, and good fortune passes to the children.

qian.jie: 拿锥子凿地找泉，用力去求反而最难；无心之间遇上知己，携手一起往上走。
qian.gloss: An awl digging for a spring: hard work finds little, but by chance a true friend appears and you rise together.

qian.jie: 躲在岩下像鸟儿栖身，终究要像个大丈夫站出来；光靠算计，走不了多远。
qian.gloss: Sheltering under the cliff like a nesting bird, one must stand up as a grown man; schemes alone carry no one far.

qian.jie: 一路奔波，处处受阻，涉水又翻山；再跑到外乡去求事，千里万里难回头。
qian.gloss: Rushing on, blocked again and again, through mud and over mountains; looking for work far away, the road home is long.

qian.jie: 松柏长得正茂，风霜雨雪都奈何不了；有朝一日成了栋梁，功名自成。
qian.gloss: Pines and cypresses stand strong; snow and frost do them no harm. One day they become the beams of a great hall.

qian.jie: 别做私心的事，有话摊开来说；心里光明磊落，像明月正挂中天。
qian.gloss: Do nothing for selfish ends; speak it openly. A clear heart shines like the moon at the height of the sky.

qian.jie: 宝贝就藏在身边，偏要跑到外乡去找，像提着灯去找火；不如收心，看看近处。
qian.gloss: Treasure lies hidden at home while you search far away — like carrying a lamp to look for fire. Stop and look nearer.

qian.jie: 想做成大事是可以的，只是家里的亲事一时忙乱；到头来必有所成，有贵人指路。
qian.gloss: Great things can be done, though family matters keep you busy; in the end a patron shows the way.

qian.jie: 坏运转好运只在咫尺；有君子下山来相交，虎兔之年有好消息；立定志向，忙事也变闲。
qian.gloss: Bad turns to good in a moment; a worthy friend comes down the mountain. Good news comes in the years of the tiger and the hare.

qian.jie: 生在富贵人家，眼前样样华美；得人赐下紫金腰带，四海扬名。
qian.gloss: Born in a rich house, surrounded by fine things, given a purple-and-gold sash: a good name across the land.

qian.jie: 像仙鹤出了笼子，条条路都通；东南西北没有阻碍，尽可直上九霄。
qian.gloss: Like a crane let out of its cage: every road opens, nothing blocks you, straight up to the ninth heaven.

qian.jie: 出门的人一肚子怨气，忽有灾事别往前凑；巢破了鸟没处歇，找个深处安稳待着。
qian.gloss: The traveller fumes at the day; when trouble comes, stay back. The nest is broken — find a quiet, deep place to rest.

qian.jie: 愁眉暂时舒开，喜事从云外来；像泥土里藏着美玉，终有良工把你荐出来。
qian.gloss: The furrowed brow eases; joy comes out of the clouds. Jade hidden in the dirt is found by a good craftsman.

qian.jie: 别听闲话是非，早晚静下心来；把狂话当真，就像画饼充饥。
qian.gloss: Do not listen to idle talk of right and wrong; keep a quiet mind. Taking wild words as true is like eating a painted cake.

qian.jie: 日落月升，古往今来循环不息；不论做哪一行的人，都能各遂心意。
qian.gloss: The sun sets, the moon rises, round and round since ancient times: whoever you are, things go your way.

qian.jie: 急流滩头放船回家，风浪正起；想要平安，就等浪静了再过这一关。
qian.gloss: Steering a boat home over the rapids, with wind and waves rising: to be safe, wait for calm water before you cross.

qian.jie: 春天久雨终于放晴，日月渐渐明亮；旧事散去，新事顺遂，眼看一跃过龙门。
qian.gloss: After long spring rain the sky clears; sun and moon grow bright. Old troubles fade, new things go well — a leap past the Dragon Gate.

qian.jie: 阴阳相合，都由天定；男婚女嫁，欢欢喜喜，一家团圆。
qian.gloss: Yin and yang meet as heaven wills: a happy marriage, dragon and snake together, a family made whole.

qian.jie: 久旱田里都枯了，一场甘雨淋下来，花果草木都润了，才知一场雨值千金。
qian.gloss: In the drought the fields are parched; then sweet rain pours. Everything grows green — one rain is worth a thousand gold.

qian.jie: 想去月宫折桂，何必担心天门不开；忽然来个好消息，人人笑逐颜开。
qian.gloss: Reaching for the laurel in the moon palace, why fear heaven's gate is shut? Good news comes, and everyone laughs.

qian.jie: 理说不清，家也不成，心性像落花随水漂；想求人帮忙得自己出力，到头来事情乱如麻。
qian.gloss: No reason, no home; a fickle heart like a falling flower. Ask for favour and you will need effort; in the end things are tangled.

qian.jie: 几重忧患都过去了，从今重新站稳；放宽心自有办法，遇到高人还能立大功。
qian.gloss: Past several worries and dangers, from now on you stand firm. A calm mind finds its own way; a wise person helps you to great things.

qian.jie: 消息上下传来传去，越传越虚；远方来信说功名能成，到头来也是一场空。
qian.gloss: Word passes up and down and turns to nothing; a letter from far away promises success, yet to the end it is empty.

qian.jie: 每个机会都前思后想，不敢动手；时候一到有贵人相助，便像山壁一样稳稳立住。
qian.gloss: Each plan, each chance, weighed back and forth, never dared. When the time comes a patron helps, and you stand as firm as a mountain.

qian.jie: 东边月亮升起正美，转眼被云遮住却还在；月有圆缺，说它不好的话也只是闲话。
qian.gloss: The moon rises in the east, lovely; clouds cover it for a while. It waxes and wanes — and talk against it is only talk.

qian.jie: 宝剑在匣里不沾尘，被贵人拿出来便光芒耀眼，有威有势，人人敬服。
qian.gloss: A sword in its sheath gathers no dust; drawn out by a patron, it shines, and everyone respects it.

qian.jie: 劝你别去求人：像鹤飞来撞上暗箭，像上山砍柴草里藏蛇，小心被人中伤。
qian.gloss: Do not go asking others for help: like a crane flying into a hidden arrow, like a snake in the grass when you gather firewood.

qian.jie: 安安静静坐着，没什么好愁；饿了吃，困了睡，放下身心别忙，自然不招冤祸。
qian.gloss: Sit in peace with nothing to worry about; eat when hungry, sleep when tired. Let go and no wrong or harm will come.

qian.jie: 前程看着渺茫其实没错；美玉藏在石头里没人知道，一朝良匠剖开，才见碧玉。
qian.gloss: The way ahead is dim but sure: jade hides inside the stone, and when a good craftsman cuts it open, all is well.

qian.jie: 你身上就藏着无价之宝，何必向外找；不如等识货的高人来，心放宽些，再宽些。
qian.gloss: You hold priceless treasure within; why look outside? Wait for someone who knows its worth, and keep your heart easy.

qian.jie: 进退出入都讲礼义，说话忠实守信；心里不明白时先静下来，自会像正午的太阳一样亮。
qian.gloss: Courteous in going and coming, true in word and deed; if the heart is unclear, be still — the red sun stands at noon.

qian.jie: 重整家风，看似无功其实有功；扫掉路上的荆棘，三人一起商量，事情就和顺。
qian.gloss: Put the family's old ways back in order; what looks like no merit is merit. Clear the thorns from the road; three agree as one.

qian.jie: 眼前的病与讼都不必忧心，好地方的钱财尽可去求；像猴子脱了锁链，自在回山去。
qian.gloss: Illness and lawsuits need no worry; there is wealth to be sought. Like a monkey freed from its chain, back home to its cave.

qian.jie: 想等身安运顺，风里的灯烛最不稳；不如收拾好在深堂静坐，灯光才不摇。
qian.gloss: Wait for peace and better luck; a candle in the wind is no good. Better sit quietly inside, where the light stays steady.

qian.jie: 月照着安静的屋子，忽然云雾一遮又昏暗了；放宽心，云散之后，正好改个做法。
qian.gloss: Moonlight on a quiet house, suddenly lost in cloud and mist. Keep faith and the clouds will part; then is the time to act.

qian.jie: 远方的消息难以揣测，别多心也别强求；把石头磨成镜子，只是白费功夫。
qian.gloss: News from far away is hard to read; do not hope too hard. Grinding a stone into a mirror is wasted work.

qian.jie: 日落月升，阴长阳消，百事亨通；若是女子来问，更添财禄福气。
qian.gloss: The sun sets, the moon rises; yin grows and all goes well. For a woman especially: wealth and blessing increase.

qian.jie: 这些好话要记住：别认贼作子；别贪眼前一点甜，往后还要吃苦。
qian.gloss: Remember these good words: do not take a thief for your son. Do not crave a little sweetness now and suffer later.

qian.jie: 圣恩终会降下，再祈福还能添福；众生都受益，天上人间都亨通。
qian.gloss: The ruler's grace returns; pray and blessings grow. Everyone shares in it, in heaven and on earth.

qian.jie: 天地变通，万物俱全；自己经营自己养，安然自得，事事如意。
qian.gloss: Heaven and earth turn and all things are whole; you keep and care for yourself in peace. Everything goes as you wish.

qian.jie: 棋逢对手，黑白还没分出胜负；输赢只在一着，要好好推敲。
qian.gloss: Evenly matched at the board, black and white still undecided: one move decides it, so think it through.

qian.jie: 自古柔能克刚，积善人家大吉大昌；抽到这签，就像口渴时遇到琼浆。
qian.gloss: Gentleness has always beaten force; a house that does good prospers. Like finding sweet drink when you are thirsty.

qian.jie: 劝你耐心守着老本行，定住心别起坏念；等有人轻轻一助，枯树也会再开花。
qian.gloss: Keep to your old work patiently, keep your heart steady and do no wrong; when help comes, the old tree flowers again.

qian.jie: 锦上添花，颜色更鲜；运来禄马双全，别怨功名来得晚，一举成名天下知。
qian.gloss: Flowers on brocade, the colours brighter still; luck brings rank and wealth together. Late success is still success, known far and wide.

qian.jie: 秋天小鸟化作大鹏，自在高飞，翱翔万里云霄，别的鸟都追不上。
qian.gloss: In autumn the small bird becomes the great roc and soars ten thousand miles, where no other bird can follow.

qian.jie: 天寒地冻，水都结了冰，何必贪着去求功名；守着自己静静坐，等时候变了自然明白。
qian.gloss: Heaven is cold, the earth frozen, the water turned to ice: do not chase fame now. Keep still; the time will change.

qian.jie: 五湖四海任你走，高挂风帆自在行；顺风一到，满船宝贝，喜事一层又一层。
qian.gloss: Sail the five lakes and four seas, sails high; with a fair wind you arrive, the boat full of treasure.

qian.jie: 夏天日长天热，人人闷得慌；天地也懂人心，一阵和风自然吹凉。
qian.gloss: The long hot summer day, everyone sweltering; heaven understands, and a cool breeze comes by itself.

qian.jie: 水里捞月，费尽功夫还是一场空；别说闲话乱语，白白劳神，反落得孤单。
qian.gloss: Fishing the moon out of the water: all that effort and nothing caught. Say nothing idle; do not wear yourself out alone.

qian.jie: 失意转成得意，龙吟虎啸正相宜；青天自有通天的路，功名一定可期。
qian.gloss: Disappointment turns to success; dragon and tiger call together. The blue sky has its road; success will come.

qian.jie: 梦里得宝，醒来就没了，像南柯一梦一场空；问婚姻或问病，都该另找门路。
qian.gloss: Treasure found in a dream, gone on waking — an empty dream. For marriage or illness, look for another way.

qian.jie: 父亲贤德传给子孙，衣食丰足全靠天；堂上父母快乐，饿了吃，渴了喝，困了睡。
qian.gloss: A good father passes it down to his sons and grandsons; enough food and clothing; parents happy; eat, drink and sleep in peace.

qian.jie: 小溪石滩水声响，清风明月下贵人正忙；路要问清楚往哪走，别贪林中花草香。
qian.gloss: The stream sounds over small stones; the breeze and the moon keep the great busy. Ask the way, and leave the flowers in the wood alone.

qian.jie: 是非闲话像风吹过耳边；好衣好禄自然丰足；别记着当年的事，你我想的其实一样。
qian.gloss: Gossip is wind past the ear; good clothes and fortune come by themselves. Forget the old grudges: you and I think alike.

qian.jie: 直话要记住：别到外乡学别的手艺；守住老本行，其他的都不利。
qian.gloss: Remember plain words: do not seek a new trade far away. Keep to your old work; anything else will not go well.

qian.jie: 爬上高楼躲起来，四周荆棘围成林；寿数长短由天，得到一个却失去两个。
qian.gloss: Hiding high in a tower ringed with thorns; how long one lives is heaven's. Gain one, lose two.

qian.jie: 抱着柴去救火，只会越烧越旺；问荣华或问出门，不如收手，别白费心。
qian.gloss: Fighting fire with firewood only spreads the blaze. For honour or for going out, better to put it away and stop.

qian.jie: 日落吟诗，月下唱歌，逢场作戏笑呵呵；遇见的事藏不住，大家一起唱和。
qian.gloss: Poems at sunset, songs under the moon, laughing along with it all; what is met cannot be hidden, and all sing together.

qian.jie: 早晚都有神佛扶持，遇到危险也不危；得贵人引路时，钱财也跟着来。
qian.gloss: Morning and evening the Buddha holds you up; danger comes and is not danger. When a patron leads you, wealth follows.

qian.jie: 往年行船丢了针，今天还在海里找；就算找着了，也费工夫费心思。
qian.gloss: The needle lost at sea from a boat long ago, searched for again today: even if you find it, it costs time and heart.

qian.jie: 鱼在碧池里游，撞上四面的罗网；想不出办法翻身，到头来惹出是非。
qian.gloss: A fish in a green pool runs into a net on every side; it finds no way out, and trouble follows.

qian.jie: 眼前的欢喜还算不上欢喜，不危险也不安稳；割肉补疮何必，不如守旧等时机。
qian.gloss: Joy now is not yet joy; neither danger nor peace. Cutting flesh to patch a sore is no help — keep to the old and wait.

qian.jie: 路险马乏人又急，像掉队的兵困在一处；滩高浪大船桨断，天晚花残又降霜。
qian.gloss: The road is steep, the horse tired, the traveller hurried; soldiers cut off; the boat broken by waves; flowers fade in the frost.

qian.jie: 一条金线称你的心，不增不减不偏不倚；为人一生正直，文章才艺都光明。
qian.gloss: A golden thread weighs your heart: nothing more, nothing less. Upright all your life, your learning and skill shine.

qian.jie: 门庭喜庆非常，积善人家大吉大昌；婚姻田蚕样样顺，有病遇上好药就安康。
qian.gloss: Joy at the gate; a house that does good prospers. Marriage, fields and silkworms all go well; illness meets its cure.

qian.jie: 冬天岭上一枝梅，叶落枝枯也不折；只等春天悄悄到来，依旧开成花中第一。
qian.gloss: A plum branch on the winter ridge: leaves fall, the branch is bare, but it never breaks. When spring comes it flowers first.

qian.jie: 天天像采花的蜂，飞了西南又飞东；春尽花残没处找，心却还守着老路线。
qian.gloss: Every day like a bee among flowers, flying south-west, then east; when spring ends there is nothing to find, yet it keeps its old path.

qian.jie: 苍龙降到大街上；一张弓射出两支箭；骑龙跨马，终能安居。
qian.gloss: The green dragon comes down to the road; one bow, two arrows; riding the dragon, you settle in peace.

qian.jie: 养蜂想要蜜，就怕被尾针蛰；眼前虽有别的路，暗里却深如荆棘林。
qian.gloss: To keep bees for honey, beware the sting; there may be another road ahead, but it is dark and thorny.

qian.jie: 春雷一响百虫都醒，一翻身离开泥里；出入来往之间，有朝一日化成龙。
qian.gloss: Spring thunder wakes the insects; turning over, out of the mud; going out and coming back, one day it becomes a dragon.

qian.jie: 像天鹅自己飞进笼子，想翻身却出不去，东南西北都难脱身。
qian.gloss: Like a swan flying into a cage: it tries to turn but cannot get out, north, south, east or west.

qian.jie: 像抱着老虎翻高山，战战兢兢吓破了胆；幸好山前遇到高手，才保住一身平安。
qian.gloss: Like carrying a tiger over a high mountain, trembling with fear; luckily a skilled hand ahead keeps you safe.

qian.jie: 鱼龙混在一起；耐心守在深潭等运通，不知不觉一朝出头，跃过龙门。
qian.gloss: Fish and dragon mixed together; wait in the deep pool for luck to turn. One morning you rise and leap the Dragon Gate.

qian.jie: 梦里说发了大财，名声远在云外，终究是虚的；路远山遥难以当真，等贵人指点才笑开颜。
qian.gloss: Riches talked of in a dream; fame beyond the clouds is empty; far roads, hard to trust — until a patron points the way and you smile.

qian.jie: 冷水还没烧开，不冷不热刚好温；走遍天下也没事，因为你身上本事多。
qian.gloss: Cold water not yet boiled: neither cold nor hot, just warm. Travel anywhere and no harm comes, for you have many skills.

qian.jie: 许愿求平安，平安得了愿还没还；别忘了该还的要还，神明的话别轻慢。
qian.gloss: A vow made for peace: the peace was kept but the vow not yet repaid. Do not forget to repay it; do not take the gods' word lightly.

qian.jie: 一路登上仙岩去学仙，有一天被帝王召见；青天日月常照，心正名声传四海。
qian.gloss: Climbing the immortals' cliff to learn the way, one day you are called to court. Sun and moon shine; an upright heart is known far and wide.

qian.jie: 梧桐叶落，秋天将尽，行人归心似箭；多谢天公出力，顺风船载着珍宝回来。
qian.gloss: Plane leaves fall as autumn ends; the traveller hurries home like a cloud. Thanks to heaven, a fair wind brings the boat home full of treasure.

qian.jie: 烈火冲天，火里却长出一朵莲；到底成了也不受害，枝叶生长，根还在。
qian.gloss: Flames fill the sky, and in the fire a lotus grows. In the end no harm is done; the leaves grow and the root holds.

qian.jie: 像初三、四、五的月亮，一半有一半无还没圆；等到十五的好夜，处处光明处处圆。
qian.gloss: Like the moon on the third, fourth and fifth nights, half there, not yet full: wait for the fifteenth, and it shines everywhere.

qian.jie: 为了名声丢了德行，图什么呢，只怕吉里变凶；喝醉了不知往哪去，在青松影里迷迷糊糊做梦。
qian.gloss: Losing virtue for a name, what is the use? Luck may turn to trouble. Drunk, not knowing where you are going, dreaming under the pines.

qian.jie: 云雾遮住山前的路，春残花尽又会再开；若能读书醒梦，贵人引你一步步登高。
qian.gloss: Clouds and fog hide the mountain road; spring ends, flowers fall and bloom again. Wake from the dream through study, and a patron leads you up.

qian.jie: 春来花开照亮阳台，万里外车马运来宝财；像跃过禹门三级浪，平地一声雷。
qian.gloss: Spring flowers light the terrace; carts come from afar with treasure. Like leaping the Dragon Gate's three waves — thunder on flat ground.

qian.jie: 人走到半山，太阳已落到山头，陡崖还不安稳；抬头求天保佑，这身子依旧太平。
qian.gloss: Halfway up the ridge with the sun on the hills, the cliffs not safe yet; look to heaven for protection, and you are still at peace.

qian.jie: 门口一只木头老虎，看着威风却不伤人；分明没什么可防的，只是心里忧疑，自己吓自己。
qian.gloss: A tiger of wood stands at the gate: it looks fierce but harms no one. It is plainly nothing to fear, yet worry keeps you uneasy.

qian.jie: 出门谋事大吉大昌，像无瑕美玉藏在石里；得贵人指引时，便得宝风光。
qian.gloss: Going out and making plans: great luck. Flawless jade hidden in the stone; when a patron guides you, you find the treasure and shine.

qian.jie: 忽然一封信飞上天，泰山宝贝满船回；问路途，好事能成，前面还有贵人推一把。
qian.gloss: Word flies up to heaven; the boat comes home full of treasure. Ask about the road: it goes well, and there is still help ahead.

qian.jie: 舒开愁眉，走到人前来；前途一变，喜事多财；一条大路宽如天，肯施舍的人都会畅快。
qian.gloss: Lift your brows and step forward; the way ahead changes, with joy and wealth. A road as wide as the sky; whatever you give comes back.

qian.jie: 从小经商会谋划，财禄丰足不用去求；若是求上进，秀才出门，状元回来。
qian.gloss: A trader since youth, full of plans, with wealth that comes unasked. If you seek advancement: the scholar goes out and comes back first in the land.

qian.jie: 鸾凤的羽毛被雨压垂，此时被麻雀欺负；忽有一天云开雨霁，照样展翅高飞。
qian.gloss: The phoenix's feathers weighed down by rain, mocked by sparrows; one day the sky clears and it spreads its wings again.

qian.jie: 君子别学小人的做法，事情一出差错就惹是非；琴要知音来听，守常安静才合宜。
qian.gloss: A gentleman does not act like a petty man; a slip brings trouble. A zither needs a friend who knows its music; keep steady and calm.

qian.jie: 志气功业天天在长，如今却沉迷酒色收不住；等金鸡报晓，钱财福禄自会招来。
qian.gloss: Your will and work grow day by day, but wine and pleasure are too much. When the golden rooster calls, wealth and blessing come.

qian.jie: 巍峨的宝塔非同寻常，八面玲珑都放光；劝你立志勤修，行善自有上天降福。
qian.gloss: A great pagoda, out of the ordinary, shining on all eight sides: set your heart on doing good, and heaven sends blessing.

qian.jie: 风里点烛只照出空影，恍惚像镜中的花；孩子们来回收拾几次，到头来总是一场空。
qian.gloss: A candle in the wind casts empty shadows, like flowers in a mirror; the children come again and again to gather them, and gather nothing.

qian.jie: 出门谋事要慢；一急怕惹出闲愁是非；像鸟飞进罗网，要脱身得等好些时候。
qian.gloss: Plans for going out should wait; hurry brings worry and trouble. Like a bird flown into a net — how long until it gets free?

qian.jie: 勒马扬鞭直冲过来，一半是忧一半是灾；像房子遭了火，天降及时雨，把灰都冲净了。
qian.gloss: Riding straight in with whip in hand: half worry, half trouble, like a house burned down — and then heaven's rain washes the ashes away.

qian.jie: 神佛灵验，你心里明白；糊涂人说事只会越说越乱；老人求了签走了，不如守旧等时机。
qian.gloss: The gods are clear to you; a foolish person only grows more confused. The old man takes his stick and goes: better to keep to the old ways and wait.
